label: PF Backlog 587
title: EPIC: Product-generation run (dogfood) execution + monitoring correctness
body:
## Problem / why
core/dogfood.py only enqueues the pipeline then immediately validates the baseline worktree, so it cannot
return a real PASS/FAIL; it never waits, and the DOGFOOD validation profile's quality_gate check is
unreachable for e2e runs. dogfood_run/schedule inherit this.

## Goal / value
dogfood drives the same engine to completion (all stages/agents), then validates the generated product and
returns a fail-closed PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED; progress is observable via the shared event bus.

## In scope
- Run-to-completion + correct post-run validation + fail-closed verdict; DOGFOOD-profile quality_gate gap.
- Consumes the Eventing SSOT bus for progress/terminal signals (sibling epic).

## Out of scope
- A dogfood-specific engine/store; the Eventing bus itself.

## Acceptance criteria
- A dogfood on a small idea reaches all stages/agents, then reports PASS only when the generated product
  passes the DOGFOOD profile; dry/timeout/could-not-start never report PASS.

## Verification / test plan
- Gate/tests: dogfood_check + dogfood_run_check updated; e2e observation via events.

## Dependencies & links
- Eventing SSOT epic; ENG-9 (core/dogfood.py); BI-PF-0458/0459/0460.
